draft.subject: Following up on your Wrenfield setup
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Good news on your pagination question — Tariq confirmed in that thread that list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, and the ticket is now closed. Shout if anything there is still unclear.

Since our welcome call, you've got your first project up, which is the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, with tasks living inside them. The usual next step is bringing the rest of the team in — a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk through that with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Chidi
